title: NeuroBreak: Unveil Internal Jailbreak Mechanisms in Large Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2509.03985v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Jailbreak attacks bypass the safety alignment of large language models (LLMs) to elicit harmful outputs, yet the vast parameter space makes diagnosing the underlying failure mechanisms extremely challenging. We present NeuroBreak, a visual analytics system that helps experts progressively unpack jailbreak mechanisms from layer-level semantics down to neuron-level behaviors. A layer-wise probing pipeline traces how harmful representations evolve across layers, while a dual-dimensional character--behavior categorization reveals each safety-related neuron's inherent tendency and contextual contribution. These analyses are made interpretable through tailored visualization designs: a task-driven probing projection that reveals safety decision boundaries, a dual-stream semantic evolution flow that traces cross-layer semantic shifts, and a character--behavior chord graph that unifies neuron roles, attribution scores, and collaborative

translated_title: NeuroBreak：揭示大语言模型内部越狱机制
translated_abstract: 越狱攻击会绕过大语言模型（LLM）的安全对齐以诱使其产生有害输出，然而庞大的参数空间使得诊断潜在的失效机制极具挑战性。我们提出了NeuroBreak，这是一个可视化分析系统，帮助专家从层级语义逐步深入到神经元级行为来剖析越狱机制。逐层探测管线追踪有害表示在各层之间的演化过程，同时双维度的“特征—行为”分类揭示每个安全相关神经元的固有倾向及其情境贡献。这些分析通过定制化的可视化设计变得可解释：任务驱动的探测投影揭示安全决策边界，双流语义演化流追踪跨层语义变化，以及统一呈现神经元角色、归因分数和协作关系的特征—行为弦图。
tldr: 提出了可视化分析系统NeuroBreak，通过逐层探测与神经元级“特征—行为”分析，从层级语义到神经元行为逐步揭示大语言模型越狱攻击的内部机制。
en_tdlr: NeuroBreak is a visual analytics system that progressively unveils internal jailbreak mechanisms in large language models from layer-level semantics down to neuron-level behaviors.
